# Zoho

Zoho is a suite of cloud applications including CRM, email marketing, and collaboration tools, enabling businesses to automate and scale operations

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zoho/.

## Actions

- **Convert Zoho CRM Lead**: Converts a lead into a contact, account, and optionally a deal in zoho crm.
- **Create Zoho CRM Record**: Creates new records in a specified module in zoho crm.
- **Create Zoho CRM Tag**: Creates new tags in zoho crm.
- **Get Zoho CRM Records** (read-only): Retrieves records from a specified module in zoho crm.
- **Update Related Records in Zoho CRM**: Associates or updates relationships between records across different modules in zoho crm.
- **Update Zoho CRM Record**: Updates existing records in a specified module in zoho crm.
